title: How many faces, edges and vertices does a triangular prism have?
description: The video counts the faces, edges and vertices of a triangular prism, one kind at a time. Keeko's doubt is that the prism has six edges.
teaching_notes: One idea: count each kind of part on its own, using the two triangles and the edges that join them. Watch for students who forget the edges that join the two triangles.

source: Count the faces, edges and vertices of a triangular prism.
video_script.why: The child has met faces, edges and vertices in the book and now counts them for a prism that is new.
video_script.substitution: Count the faces, the edges and the vertices separately, using the two triangles and the parts that join them.
video_script.anchor: a triangular prism, shaped like a tent, with two triangles at its ends
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko counts only the edges of the two triangles, three and three, and says the prism has six edges. Three more edges join the corners of the two triangles, so the prism has nine edges.
video_script.payoff_line: A triangular prism has five faces, nine edges and six vertices

final_answer.spoken: five faces, nine edges and six vertices

maths_rules: faces are the flat surfaces, edges are the line segments of the faces, vertices are where edges meet
edges: 3 on each triangle and 3 joining them, 3 + 3 + 3 = 9
slip: counting only the edges of the triangles gives 6 edges
video_script.design: A triangular prism stands on the stage; each kind of part glows in turn as it is counted, and the count is written beside it.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a triangular prism like a tent; three labels faces, edges and vertices each with a question mark

marks.book: the title card and the prism appear
marks.ask: the three labels appear with question marks

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about solids with flat surfaces.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Here is a triangular prism, shaped like a tent. How many faces, edges and vertices does it have?

beats.on_screen: the prism and the three labels stay on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a cube with one face shaded, one edge traced and one vertex marked; the labels face, edge and vertex written beside them

marks.face: one flat surface of the cube is shaded and named a face
marks.edge: one line segment of the cube is traced and named an edge
marks.vertex: one place where edges meet is marked and named a vertex

narration: <bookmark mark='face'/>A face is a flat surface that forms the boundary of a solid.
<bookmark mark='edge'/>An edge is a line segment that forms the side of a face.
<bookmark mark='vertex'/>A vertex is a place where edges meet. A cube has six faces, twelve edges and eight vertices.

beats.on_screen: Given: triangular prism. Two triangles are opposite faces. The other faces are rectangles.

marks.given: the two triangles and the rectangles are labelled on the prism

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, a triangular prism has two triangles as opposite faces. Its other faces are rectangles.

marks.find: the three words faces, edges and vertices are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the faces, the edges and the vertices of the prism.
<bookmark mark='tri'/>Step one, count the faces. There are two triangles at the ends.
<bookmark mark='rect'/>There are three rectangles that run along the sides of the prism.
<bookmark mark='calc'/>Two plus three is five, so there are five faces in all.

beats.on_screen: Edges: 3 on each triangle and 3 joining them: 3 + 3 + 3 = 9

marks.front: the three edges of the front triangle glow
marks.join: the three edges joining the triangles glow and 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='front'/>Step two, count the edges. The front triangle has three edges, and the back triangle has three.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Three more edges join the corners of the two triangles. Three plus three plus three is nine edges.

marks.corners: the three corners of each triangle are marked with dots

narration: <bookmark mark='corners'/>Step three, count the vertices. Each triangle has three corners, and the joining edges add no new ones.
<bookmark mark='calc'/>Three plus three is six, so the prism has six vertices.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>A triangular prism has five faces, nine edges and six vertices.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the prism
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows 3 + 3 = 6 edges, struck through; the three joining edges glow on the prism

marks.doubt: the bubble with 3 + 3 = 6 appears beside the prism
marks.join: the three joining edges glow on the prism
marks.fix: the bubble is struck through and 9 edges returns

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the prism has six edges, because each triangle has three edges.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Look at the prism again. Three more edges join the corners of one triangle to the corners of the other.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Those edges count too, so the prism has nine edges.
